premises.text: Restaurants have perishable inventory that leads to lost opportunities if not sold.
premises.evidence_span: If a restaurant is not able to sell a table at 7 o'clock in the evening, it's a lost opportunity for the restaurants.

premises.text: High fixed costs contribute to the financial pressure on restaurants.
premises.evidence_span: Restaurants have very high fixed costs. The rents are already paid for. The utilities are already running. The staff is already standing.

premises.text: A significant portion of restaurant inventory is underutilized due to lack of revenue management.
premises.evidence_span: about 40 percent of the restaurant inventory is underutilized due to lack of revenue or yield management.

premises.text: The restaurant industry faces a high failure rate, particularly in the first few years.
premises.evidence_span: About 30 percent of the restaurants would fail during the first year of their operation. And unfortunately, this number goes up to 60 percent by the third year.

premises.text: Dynamic pricing can help restaurants optimize their pricing based on demand and supply.
premises.evidence_span: ResGuru is a dynamic pricing platform for restaurants. It allows the restaurants to automatically change their prices based on demand and supply.

premises.text: Utilization metrics are critical for assessing restaurant performance.
premises.evidence_span: One of the key metrics out here is utilization. My restaurant's utilization is only about 56%.

premises.text: Forecasting demand accurately is essential for pricing strategy in restaurants.
premises.evidence_span: ResGuru is doing in the background is taking into account 21 different variables, macro and micro data points, and along with historical trends to forecast the demand for me.

value.text: Restaurants can optimize their revenue and reduce food waste through dynamic pricing.
value.evidence_span: this will not only help them optimize their revenue, but also get you better deals in your restaurants.

notes: Statistics on restaurant failure rates and food waste illustrate the challenges faced by the industry.
